summary_text: On 2026-02-24 (weekday), one unit of Nestle Cerelac Wheat Apple Baby Food Cereal (350 g) was purchased in the afternoon. This timing aligns with the population afternoon baseline share (0.2526), though it is less common than morning (0.3246) or evening (0.3027) baselines. The product is a standard infant food item intended for early solid food introduction. This is a single observation on one date; it is not yet possible to determine if this represents a stable preference for this specific brand, flavor, or timing, or if it was a one-time purchase. No other baby cereal purchases are recorded in this window to establish a pattern.
